2608.04830.title: ContextWeave: A Real-World Workflow Benchmark
2608.04830.paper_summary: Memory is essential as language agents move from isolated tasks to long-horizon, stateful workflows, yet existing evaluations often reduce it to retrieval or question answering. We introduce ContextWeave, a longitudinal benchmark that evaluates whether recalled experience improves downstream agent performance in realistic office-work streams. ContextWeave reconstructs privacy-preserved, multi-month workflows of 14 participants into 1,005 executable tasks, including 568 core evaluation tasks, with instructions, containerized environments, trajectories, and task-specific rubrics. It measures workspace quality and alignment with participant-specific preferences, complemented by diagnostics of relevance, continuity, solvability, and robustness to misleading recall. Across six memory components under a fixed model, the strongest configuration raises Workspace Score from 68.08 to 78.20 and Preference Score from 41.50 to 70.60. With a fixed memory component, recall improves both outcomes for all five tested base models, although gains vary substantially. Our analysis shows that actionable, experience-rich memory supports workflow continuation and reduces redundant exploration more effectively than compact summaries, while it can also be more susceptible to misleading recall. These findings motivate memory systems that optimize not only retrieval relevance but also reliable use during execution.
2608.04830.paper_summary_zh: 記憶是至關重要的，因為語言代理從孤立的任務轉向長期的、有狀態的工作流程，但現有的評估往往將其簡化為檢索或問答。我們介紹了 ContextWeave，一個縱向基準，用於評估回憶的經驗是否能改善現實辦公工作流中下游代理的表現。ContextWeave 將 14 位參與者的隱私保護的多月工作流程重建為 1,005 個可執行任務，包括 568 個核心評估任務，並附有指示、容器化環境、軌跡和任務特定的評分標準。它測量工作空間的質量以及與參與者特定偏好的對齊，並輔以相關性、連續性、可解決性和對誤導性回憶的穩健性診斷。在固定模型下的六個記憶組件中，最強的配置將工作空間得分從 68.08 提高到 78.20，偏好得分從 41.50 提高到 70.60。在固定的記憶組件下，回憶改善了所有五個測試的基礎模型的這兩個結果，儘管增益差異顯著。我們的分析顯示，具有可行性和豐富經驗的記憶比緊湊的摘要更有效地支持工作流程的延續並減少冗餘探索，雖然它也可能更容易受到誤導性回憶的影響。這些發現促使我們開發不僅優化檢索相關性，還能在執行過程中可靠使用的記憶系統。
